settings.hero_desc: A friendly mascot robot figure brought to life in 3D - clean white body, a glossy blue "eye" face and a cheerful wave. The perfect way to turn your brand character or app mascot into a real, displayable figure for reception desks, events and gifts.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your character/mascot, colours, size and branding
settings.s1_body: A mascot works hardest when people can actually see it. We turn your brand character, app icon or mascot illustration into a clean, charming 3D figure - finished in your colours with your branding - ready to greet visitors at reception, headline an event, or delight clients as a gift. Built as a one-off display piece or a batch of giveaways.
settings.case_body: Created from a brand's mascot illustration, this figure gave the character a physical presence - a friendly face for the reception desk and a memorable giveaway that made the brand stick.
settings.case_quote: Seeing our mascot as a real figure was a delight. It greets everyone who visits now.
settings.prov_p: A mascot on a screen is easy to scroll past. The same character as a physical figure becomes something people notice, photograph and remember.
